notes: Nineteen environmental review documents, one per project, for the downtown and South of Market projects of 1983-1991 — the batch that follows the 1975-1982 downtown reports. The draft was read where a project has a draft and a final. Two site tables (100 First Street and 505 Montgomery Street) print their buildings and their construction dates as two detached heaps in the text layer; both documents restate every date in prose in their impacts chapter, and that prose is what these findings are taken from. The rating columns of the vicinity tables in the 1145 Market Street and 343 Sansome Street reports did not survive their OCR, so only the names and street numbers are taken from those.
